[Act: income-tax-2025
 Chapter: Penalties
 Section: 456::Penalty for failure to furnish statement or information or document by an eligible investment fund.
]


If any eligible investment fund required to furnish a statement or any information or document under paragraph 4 of Schedule I, fails to do so within the time prescribed under the said paragraph, the income-tax authority prescribed under the said paragraph may direct that such fund shall pay, by way of penalty, a sum of Rs. 500000.

metadata.section_title: Penalty for failure to furnish statement or information or document by an eligible investment fund.
